name: Azeroth Companion
title: ATLAS INTELLIGENCE — In-App Item Discovery & Farm Progress
approval_note: User requested concrete functionality inside Atlas rather than external-site links. Curated in-app guide and existing Blizzard item gateway added; complete loot tables, interiors, and farming density are not yet verified or claimed.
features: Show in-app item acquisition steps, difficulty and source details from existing versioned Loot Hunter data.
Search Blizzard item names/IDs explicitly using existing read-only Cloudflare item API, inspect results in the Atlas rather than redirecting.
Search boss encounters and display source-backed instance boss lineup and known sample item sources.
Save Item Atlas wishlist entries, Loot Hunter farm goals and manual attempt/step progress using existing on-device storage keys.
Browse documented nearby points from one source zone without speculative travel times, respawns or heatmaps.
Collapse external source references and cross-site research behind optional disclosure.
Preserve iPhone native fullscreen modal, source image fallback, waypoints, missions and player data.
